svg.title: From the car to the cabin
svg.desc: The seats sit between the axles. Ahead of the occupants, the dashboard conceals the heater and air-conditioning unit; coolant pipes connect its heater to the rear engine. Follow the seat into its runners and body supports. At the front, a blower moves air across the evaporator and through the heater or bypass before the ducts distribute it. Numbered parts: 1 Cabin body supports; 2 Seat runners and frame; 3 Cushion and backrest; 4 Inlet, filter and blower; 5 Evaporator and valve; 6 Heater and bypass; 7 Outlet ducts; 8 Refrigerant pipes and drier; 9 Heater coolant pipes. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
